title: GrassSky
description: A soft natural sky overlay inspired by open fields and peaceful outdoor scenery.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9514cf11dfe7bf84f02cb653dfd47652510c0fd2.jpeg)

**GrassSky** a calm and grounded atmosphere inspired by nature.
With gentle tones and an open-air feeling, it enhances daytime exploration and survival worlds.

The overlay does not modify blocks or textures, making it fully compatible with most packs while adding a refreshing natural vibe.

### 🌌 Features

- Custom space sky
- Mars as the main celestial body
- Earth visible in the background
- Designed to stay readable during gameplay

### Requirements

- Needs OptiFine
- Custom Sky: ON
- Stars: ON
- Sun & Moon: ON
